Functional Age Test
6 simple tests · no equipment needed · 5–7 minutes
What you'll discover:
📊 Your functional age — how old your body actually is across 6 systems
🎯 Your weakest system — where to focus first
💡 A personal insight that will shape your MoveSpan program

Each measurement takes 1–2 minutes. No equipment needed — just you and a timer.
  • 1Resting heart rate — cardiovascular
  • 2Breathing rate — respiratory system
  • 3Forward bend — flexibility & posterior chain
  • 4Balance on one leg — nervous system
  • 5Shoulder clasp — shoulder mobility
  • 6Sitting-Rising Test — strength, flexibility & coordination

Resting Breathing Rate
Test 1 of 7

Breathe completely normally. Do not change your rhythm. Count full breath cycles for 30 seconds × 2.

One inhale + one exhale = 1 cycle.

Select your breathing rate

Test 2 of 7
Resting Heart Rate
Sit quietly for 2–3 minutes. Place 2 fingers on your wrist (inner side, below thumb) or neck. Count heartbeats for 30 seconds × 2 = beats per minute.
Test 3 of 7 — Heart Rate Recovery
20 squats in 30–35 seconds

Squat down to a comfortable depth and stand back up — 20 times in 30–35 seconds.

This test is important for accuracy.

The heart adapts to how you treat it. Movement and breath are the tools.
Test 4 of 7
Forward Bend
Stand straight, feet together, legs completely straight. Slowly bend forward and reach as low as you can. Don't bounce. Check where your hands reach.
Test 5 of 7
Balance on One Leg
Raise one leg and press its heel to the knee of your standing leg. Extend both arms forward. Eyes open! Time how long you can hold. Take the best of 2 attempts on each leg.
Test 6 of 7
Shoulder Clasp Behind the Back
Right arm: reach over your right shoulder (arm goes up then behind).
Left arm: reach behind your lower back (arm goes up from below).
Try to clasp fingers. Switch sides (left over, right under). Take the best result.
Test 7 of 7 — Sitting-Rising Test
Sit Down & Stand Up From the Floor
Cross your legs and sit down on the floor without using hands or knees for support. Then stand back up the same way — no support.
